research_notes: Name and group: PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk (unchanged; founded 1990 as PT Panganjaya Intikusuma, FS2025 Note 1a). Parent First Pacific Investment Management Ltd 50.07%, ultimate parent First Pacific Company Ltd, Hong Kong (FS2025 Note 1c, Note 21). Holding company: INDF consolidates PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk (ICBP, 80.5% effective), PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk (SIMP, 61.6%), Indofood Agri Resources Ltd (IFAR, 74.3%) and others (FS2025 Note 1e, PDF p. 24). All figures are INDF's own consolidated FS; equity_attr excludes the large non-controlling interests (Rp47.1 tn at end-2025). Do not add ICBP figures on top (ICBP would be double-counted).

Currency/units: IDR reporter (FS 'Disajikan dalam Jutaan Rupiah'); all money in IDR billion = Rp juta / 1,000. EBITDA, ROE and ROA come from the AR financial highlights (printed in Rp billion / percent).

Source policy: each FY's figures come from that year's own audited consolidated FS (FS2019-FS2025, all downloaded from indofood.com/uploads/statement/), i.e. as originally reported. FS2022 Note 4 (PDF p. 95-97) restated 31 Dec 2020/1 Jan 2021 and FY2021 for the PSAK 24 'attributing benefit to periods of service' change (employee-benefit liabilities down, equity up): FY2021 net profit attributable 7,642,197 -> 7,662,254 (EPS 870 -> 873), equity attributable 48,264,727 -> 48,535,675, total equity 86,632,111 -> 86,986,509, total assets 179,356,193 -> 179,271,840, total liabilities 92,724,082 -> 92,285,331; 31 Dec 2020 equity attributable 42,374,298 -> 42,775,704, total equity 79,138,044 -> 79,653,950 (Rp juta). Revenue and debt were not affected. The original figures are stored; restated values are in each datum's note. FS2023 re-presents FY2022 CFO (13,587,686 -> 13,624,195); original stored. FY2019 levels in FS2019 equal the FS2020 comparatives.

total_debt = short-term bank loans/overdrafts/trust receipts + current maturities of long-term debts + total long-term debts (bank loans, bonds, a small 'other' interest-bearing loan of Rp7.3-8.8 bn); for every year it equals the 'Funded Debt / Pinjaman yang Dikenakan Bunga' line of the AR financial highlights. Excluded: lease liabilities (PSAK 73), amounts due to related parties, and the US$650 m retention amount payable for ICBP's Aug-2020 acquisition of Pinehill Company Ltd (PCL) shown as 'other long-term liabilities' 9,168,257 (2020) and 'other short-term liabilities' 9,274,857 (2021) - deferred purchase consideration, not a borrowing (FS2020 Note 1, PDF p. 30-33). The 2020 jump in bank loans (36.6 tn) financed the PCL acquisition and was refinanced in 2021 by ICBP's USD global bonds (US$1.15 bn 2031, US$600 m 2051, US$600 m 2032, US$400 m 2052; FS2025 Note 19b, IR 'Bond Issuance' page). INDF's own Rupiah Bond VIII (Rp2 tn, 8.70%) matured 26 May 2022.

EBITDA: reported only in the AR 'Financial Highlights' (PDF p. 6 of every AR, Rp billion, directly under 'Income from Operations (EBIT)'), without a printed definition; the FS, interim FS, results summaries and IR pages carry none, so interim EBITDA is null. Each year's own AR value is stored; AR2022 onwards restate FY2021 EBITDA 20,753.2 -> 20,785.7 (PSAK 24).

Capex = the single cash-flow line 'Additions to fixed assets, plantations and payments of advances for fixed assets' (includes bearer plants and capex advances), which the AR highlights call 'Capital Expenditures (including advance for purchases of assets)'. 'Additions to biological assets' (Rp194-306 bn a year) is a separate investing line and is not included.

ROE/ROA are stored exactly as printed in the AR highlights; per AR footnote 4 they are TOTAL returns including non-controlling interests (income for the year incl. NCI / average total equity or total assets), so they differ from a return on equity attributable to owners computed from net_profit_attr and equity_attr.

Dividends: one final cash dividend per year, approved at the AGMS and paid in Jul-Sep; no interim or special dividends for FY2020-FY2025 (FS dividend notes FS2021 p. 150, FS2022 p. 156, FS2023 p. 136, FS2024 p. 127, FS2025 p. 127, 9M2026 p. 103; the 'Payments of cash dividends' cash-flow line equals DPS x 8,780,426,500 in every year). DPS and regular-market cum/ex/recording/payment dates from the English AGMS resolutions summaries on indofood.com; totals from the FS dividend notes. The FY2020 AGMS was held on 27 Aug 2021 (later than the June meetings of 2023-2026), so the FY2020 dividend was paid on 29 Sep 2021. The IR 'Dividends' page (https://www.indofood.com/investor-relation/dividend-history) agrees on every DPS and payment date and prints payout ratios 38/32/35/29/28/24% for FY2020-FY2025.

Corporate actions 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-04: none (no split, reverse split, bonus or rights issue). FS Note 1d share chronology (FS2025 PDF p. 22-23; also 9M2026 PDF p. 14) and the IR 'Share Listings' page end with the 27 Jun 2008 redemption of 663,762,500 treasury shares; issued shares have been 8,780,426,500 (par Rp100) ever since, with no treasury shares. The last split was the 1:5 par-value split of 20 Jul 2000. corporate_actions is therefore an empty list and fy.2019.year_end_price is not needed.

Share buyback: on 23 Oct 2026 INDF disclosed a buyback of up to Rp750 bn through the IDX between 26 Oct and 31 Dec 2026 under POJK 13/2023 (fluctuating-market rules, no AGMS needed), not exceeding 20% of paid-in capital (disclosure: https://www.indofood.com/uploads/document/ISM_KI_Rencana%20Pembelian%20Kembali%20Saham%202026_final.pdf). Nothing was executed by 30 Sep 2026; any treasury shares bought from 26 Oct 2026 will reduce shares_out from the FY2026 FS onward (execution reports are on IDX, which blocks this server - not checked).

9M2026: net sales +11.5% YoY but profit attributable -0.2% YoY (7,865.8 vs 7,881.3 bn) because of a 3.82 tn net forex loss from financing activities (9M2025: 1.60 tn; 9M2026 FS Note 30, PDF p. 111); bonds payable rose to 49.3 tn as ICBP's USD bonds were translated at a weaker rupiah. H1 2026 net profit attributable was 4,724.3 bn (buyback disclosure pro forma table, based on the 30 Jun 2026 FS).

Year-end prices are the AR share-table closes (each AR's own year; AR2020 also gives Q4-2019 close 7,925, not stored). Dec-2025 close 6,775 = market cap Rp59.49 tn / 8,780,426,500 shares (AR2025 PDF p. 21, p. 35).

AR2022 (https://www.indofood.com/uploads/annual/ISM_AR_2022.pdf) is no longer on the live site (404 on 2026-11-04; the AR page links it but the file is gone); it was fetched from the Internet Archive snapshot 20230607193548 (7,086,363 bytes). Everything else was fetched directly from www.indofood.com (no bot challenge).
